baseline_question: Do these reports refer to the same access channel and observation window, and what independent evidence would resolve the difference?

held_out_value_benchmark.question: Does private GOOL review identify new actionable evidence gaps or apparent contradictions with correct contextual citations, beyond the existing local linguistic extraction, without unsupported factual premises?
held_out_value_benchmark.proposed_design: Freeze 24 permission-eligible report bundles unseen during prompt development, stratified across denials, changed timestamps, duplicated/syndicated reports, geographic ambiguity, consistent accounts and source prompt injection. Randomize presentation of local-extraction baseline versus local-extraction plus review. Use two bounded review samples per bundle to measure instability; no paid model judge.
metrics: Citation identity rejection rate, separately from semantic judgments
Contextual citation correctness including surrounding negation and timestamps
New actionable questions per bundle beyond the baseline, with a written adjudicator rationale
Unsupported factual premise rate and unjustified contradiction rate
Abstention on consistent or insufficient bundles
Reviewer time to a defensible next source check
Disagreement between two samples per bundle
Complete call count, token usage, failures, elapsed time and actual charged cost
held_out_value_benchmark.promotion: No model quality pass from these contract fixtures. Pre-register thresholds and adjudication instructions before the held-out run. Any future public use needs separate privacy, rights, security, isolation and human-review qualification; coordinate/event mutation remains prohibited.
held_out_value_benchmark.cost: No calls authorized by this file. At execution time capture a dated provider quote, pin the exact model and provider, and reserve an explicit total token/call/USD/deadline budget with no fallback, tools, speech or judge. A bare model comparison must be labelled as such and cannot qualify full GOOL.
